name: Unbounded Consumption & Cost Abuse
description: Query volume, resource-intensive inputs or runaway agent loops that exhaust capacity or inflate the operator's inference bill.
differs: Availability/cost effect rather than compromise of behaviour; often follows another technique (e.g. an injected instruction that starts the loop). Making a model refuse on purpose is Induced Refusal (T6.002).
